title: What was Lando Norris' top-speed problem in Baku qualifying?
extract: A fuel-injection-related power issue left Lando Norris's McLaren short of straight-line speed in Azerbaijan qualifying.

title: DTM Hockenheim test: McLaren tops times
extract: Ben Dörr put his McLaren quickest at the final official DTM test, ahead of Ferrari and BMW.

title: Cadillac makes three major tech hires including former Red Bull design chief
extract: Cadillac F1 has strengthened its technical leadership with Craig Skinner, Eric Blandin and Tim Lean.

title: F1 Azerbaijan GP: George Russell takes dominant pole
extract: George Russell took his fifth pole of 2026 in Baku while Kimi Antonelli was eliminated after hitting the barriers.

title: Fernando Alonso adds a $5m Bugatti Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse
extract: Fernando Alonso has reportedly added an ultra-rare Bugatti Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse to his collection.

title: CISA warns of SharePoint, WSO2, Adobe Commerce flaws exploited in attacks
extract: CISA has added critical WSO2 and Adobe Commerce vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue.

title: Your uncle's frozen Mac says it's infected after viewing a Google ad
extract: Researchers found malicious Google ads delivering convincing fake infection warnings on Windows and macOS.

title: Microsoft plans to deprecate Windows Deployment Services
extract: Microsoft says the Windows Deployment Services server role will be deprecated beginning with the next Windows Server release.

title: 2026 just became the year of FreeBSD on the Amazonian cloud desktop
extract: New FreeBSD desktop AMIs for Amazon's cloud environment provide a more accessible graphical cloud workstation.

title: Microsoft stops insisting you need a Copilot+ PC
extract: Microsoft's new Surface laptops meet the old Copilot+ requirements but are no longer marketed under that label.

title: Binky: Frozen in Time arrives on Commodore 64
extract: Snowball Games and Thalamus Digital have released a new single-screen platformer for Commodore 64.

title: Castlevania turns 40 with a free NES original and possible 3D collection tease
extract: Konami is celebrating Castlevania's 40th anniversary by making the original NES game temporarily free on mobile.

title: Ghosts'n Goblins gets an enhanced Amiga AGA edition
extract: JOTD has released an enhanced Amiga AGA edition of Ghosts'n Goblins for Amiga 1200-class hardware.

title: JOTD teases an AGA update for Bad Dudes vs DragonNinja
extract: A new gameplay tease shows an Amiga AGA conversion gaining parallax stages, two-player support and faster graphics handling.

title: The Addams Family Backgrounds Edition aims to restore missing Amiga visuals
extract: A fan-led overhaul of Ocean's 1992 Amiga platformer is planned for October, restoring missing level backgrounds.

title: A 3v3 68010 project combines classic Motorola silicon with FPGA glue logic
extract: A hobbyist 68010 computer uses modern logic and an FPGA for bus decoding and glue logic.

title: ZX Spectrum Harlequin gets a Raspberry Pi Pico ROM emulator adapter
extract: A new hardware project uses a Raspberry Pi Pico and level shifting to emulate the ROM chip of a ZX Spectrum Harlequin.

title: Commodore 128 becomes a marine vessel tracker
extract: A modern AIS receiver has been paired with a Commodore 128 to display live maritime vessel data.

title: Nothing But Thieves discuss the introspective Stray Dogs
extract: Nothing But Thieves discuss the themes, recording approach and community behind Stray Dogs.

title: Bloc Party return with Anatomy Of A Brief Romance
extract: Bloc Party have returned with their first studio album in four years, Anatomy Of A Brief Romance.

title: U2 announce Carnaval de Luz with Dolly Parton and Rosalía
extract: U2 have announced Carnaval de Luz, their first proper new studio album in almost nine years, and released Silencio.

title: Soft Cell talk about the 'zeitgeist' coincidence behind Danceteria
extract: Marc Almond discusses Soft Cell's sixth and final album Danceteria and its coincidence with Madonna's similarly named project.

title: The Olive Green Minerva Exo Tourbillon Limited Edition 18
extract: Minerva has revived its suspended Exo Tourbillon in an 18-piece edition with olive-green guilloché, black onyx and yellow gold.

title: Favre Leuba expands the Harpoon Revival with black and blue dials
extract: Favre Leuba has expanded its vintage-inspired Harpoon Revival with black and dark-blue dials.

title: Perrelet adds four natural stone dials to the Weekend collection
extract: Perrelet has expanded its Weekend collection with turquoise, lapis lazuli, tiger's-eye and black-onyx dials.

title: Panerai introduces the Luminor Tourbillon GMT Titanio PAM01784
extract: Panerai has introduced the titanium PAM01784 Luminor Tourbillon GMT with a tourbillon and GMT complication.

title: Seismic Shift: PW Talks with Danielle L. Jensen
extract: Danielle L. Jensen discusses her epic fantasy Defy the Dusk and its dystopian setting and worldbuilding.

title: Jane Schoenbrun discusses speculative thriller Public Access Afterworld
extract: Jane Schoenbrun discusses Public Access Afterworld, a speculative thriller about a television station broadcasting from another dimension.

title: How Black Moon by Stephen Wright got made
extract: Publishers Weekly examines the creation of Stephen Wright's Black Moon, a historical adventure about an Irish orphan who becomes a pirate queen.

title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026: Agents' Hotlists
extract: The Bookseller surveys manuscripts literary agencies are backing ahead of Frankfurt 2026, highlighting forthcoming titles being offered to publishers.

title: Black Doves Season 2 trailer sends Keira Knightley back into espionage
extract: Netflix has released the first trailer for Black Doves Season 2, returning Keira Knightley and Ben Whishaw to a six-episode spy thriller arriving in November.

title: Avengers: Doomsday breaks Australian box-office presale record
extract: Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday generated more than $1 million in Australian ticket presales during its first 24 hours.

title: Backrooms begins streaming on HBO Max
extract: Kane Parsons' liminal-space horror film Backrooms has arrived on HBO Max.

title: Strange New Worlds Season 4 finale sends Uhura across time
extract: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds closes its fourth season with a time-spanning Enterprise crisis centred on Uhura and sets up the final season.
